fact: MoCTI states that a Government Enterprise Architecture Framework it developed will serve as a national guide for digital integration, after training over 100 ICT officers from MDAs in Enterprise Architecture; no adoption or issue is stated, so recorded as not yet adopted (as_of is the document's published date, 2025-10-31).

The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025) that a Government of Sierra Leone Interoperability Framework (G-SLIF) is in draft or planned; the line's own year is 2026, so the survey round's year is used.
